title: The King
summary: Slow but all-important — meet the king.

steps.text: The KING moves one square in any direction — up, down, sideways, or diagonally. He's not very fast, but he's the most important piece: if he's ever trapped with no escape, the game ends!

steps.prompt: Move the king one square diagonally, to e5.
steps.retryText: Kings only move one square at a time. Try e5.

steps.prompt: Move the king one square down, to d3.
steps.retryText: Kings only move one square at a time. Try d3.

steps.prompt: There's a pawn right in front of you — capture it!
steps.successText: The king captured the pawn safely!
steps.retryText: The pawn on d5 is one square away — capture it.

steps.text: Careful — the king can NEVER move into a square attacked by an enemy piece. We'll learn all about keeping the king safe (that's called 'check') in a later lesson.
For now, just remember: he moves one square, in any direction. Next up: pawns — the small but mighty foot soldiers!
